commits.subject: core: fixed DoubleToAscii() normalization after mul64x64()
commits.body:
Since 0fe4797b5, d2a_diy_fp_multiply() tested the normalization bit on
PQWordArray(@result.f)^[1], i.e. the QWord following result.f (the exponent
field and padding), instead of the high 32-bit half of result.f.

The surrogate cached power of ten was then left un-normalized, so e.g.
4.9406564584124654E-324 was printed as 4.2363400755900289E-309.

Restore the PQWordRec(@result.f)^.h test, as before the ASMINTELARM
refactoring. TTestCoreBase._TDynArray is green again on x86_64 and aarch64.
commits.author: zen010101
